lead: Full-Stack JavaScript architect and Team Lead. I specialize in designing and delivering SaaS platforms and marketplaces from scratch to production.
seoTitle: About Palisoft — Full-Stack JavaScript Development Studio
seoDescription: The studio of Yuri Palienko: 10+ years in development, 4+ years as a team lead. SaaS platforms, marketplaces and AI agents — architecture to production.
ogAlt: About Palisoft — Yuri Palienko, full-stack JavaScript architect and team lead

sections.heading: Experience
paragraphs: 10+ years in development, 4+ years as a Team Lead. Deep expertise in backend architecture with Node.js and NestJS, event-driven systems and high-load solutions.

For four years I led a distributed team in Rome: architecture decisions, code review, mentoring. Kept the platform stable under growing load as it scaled to 500+ corporate clients — the toprentapp.com and billionrent.com case studies describe how.

sections.heading: Own products and open source
paragraphs: These days I build my own products in EdTech, PropTech and SaaS — egesto.ru, kvartly.com, pali.rent — plus open source: Palistor, a declarative MVVM framework for React that runs in production on two of them, and paliproxy, a proxy pool manager for Node.js.

sections.heading: AI agents in production
paragraphs: A separate focus is AI agents in production: a harness with tools, subagents and a memory system for managing an application and its data. The most complete example is the AI agent inside a Power BI-grade analytics system, which builds reports and changes data models in natural language.

sections.heading: How we work
paragraphs: Palisoft is a small studio, not an agency: the person you talk to on the first call is the one who designs the architecture and writes the core of the system. When a project needs more hands, we bring in developers we have worked with before and keep the technical lead in-house.

Every project starts with architecture: data model, service boundaries, event flows and the deployment scheme are written down before the first feature. That is what lets a platform grow from zero to hundreds of B2B clients without a rewrite. Code lives in your repository from the first commit, work goes in milestones with demos, and support continues after launch.
